completeness.why: The new getRangedAmount covers only the range midpoint; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own null/number/range ternary although the existing getScheduledAmount already decides all three cases, so they are partial; schedule-template's halve-the-rounded-sum copy is untouched and not carried as an explicit variant, so none.

interface.why: Adds a narrow range-only helper beside the existing exported getScheduledAmount instead of reusing it for the whole decision, and the template's different rounding is neither routed through nor named as an explicit variation.

disguised_duplication.where: The missing/number/range dispatch stays duplicated at four sites, but it is left verbatim rather than renamed or reshaped; getScheduledAmount now delegates to the new helper instead of keeping a parallel copy.
